info.title: PaperNx
info.author: Yusuf Buzrul
info.details: Native, offline EPUB, PDF, CBZ & CBR reader for Nintendo Switch. Touch-first reading, interactive 3D page curl, manga support, themes and reading statistics.\n\n

changelog:
What's New in the v0.9.1 Re-Release
📚 Full CBR (RAR4, RAR5, Solid) & Enhanced CBZ Reader
Comprehensive CBR & CBZ Support: Built-in reader engine supporting .cbz (ZIP) and .cbr (RAR4, RAR5, non-solid and solid archives via vendored unarr decoder).
Magic-Byte Sniffing: Automatically detects and loads archives regardless of whether they have a .cbz or .cbr file extension.
Pure RGB High-Fidelity Rendering: Renders original artwork colors faithfully; outer viewport margins seamlessly match the active book or global theme (e.g., Vintage Sepia, Charcoal, OLED Black), eliminating bright white borders.
Reversible Comic Reading Palette: Optional reading palette available in reader settings for inverted or dark reading modes.
ComicInfo.xml Metadata: Full extraction of Title, Writer/Penciller, Series, Issue Number, Genre, Manga reading direction, FrontCover specification, and Page Bookmarks.
Security & Safety Bounds: Strict in-memory processing (no SD card extraction, rejects path traversal and symlinks, 48 MiB per-image safety limit, 100 megapixel cap).
Expanded Cover Worker Budget: 96 MiB worker budget for high-resolution comic covers with automatic fallback to subsequent pages if page 0 is damaged.
📖 Interactive 3D Perspective Page Curl (Page Flip)
Authentic Physical Curl: Developed around an inclined, tapered cylinder mesh via SDL_RenderGeometry (with proportional scaled fallback).
Interactive Finger Tracking: Follows finger hold position, touch grip height (anchorY), vertical drag displacement (dragY), paper underside tint, specular highlight, and contact shadow.
Physics Commit/Cancel: Fast flick thresholds commit the turn; slow releases return paper to its resting edge.
Universal Format Support: Works across paginated EPUB, PDF, CBZ, and CBR (including RTL manga page reading direction and zoomed comic sheets).
User Toggle: Persisted setting in Settings → Navigation (Sayfa çevirme animasyonu: Açık/Kapalı / Page curl animation: On/Off, default on).
🗂️ Comic Series Grouping & Multi-Tab Navigation
Automated Series Shelving: Collapses multi-issue comic series (recognizing #1, 01, v01, Vol 01, Cilt 01, and ComicInfo.xml tags) into single series shelf cards in the library.
3-Tab Contents Modal: Cleanly separated tabs for Chapters (Bölümler), All Pages grid (Tüm sayfalar), and Bookmarks (Yer imleri).
Background Preview Cache: Lazy thumbnail generation for the pages grid and live footer scrubber preview bubble.
One-Tap Zoom Reset: Prominent on-screen "Fit page" pill (Sayfaya sığdır) appears when zoomed in to restore 1.0x view instantly.
Smooth Controller Zoom & Pan: Continuous trigger zoom (ZL/ZR) with equal acceleration over time, and smooth fractional D-pad / analog stick panning.
⚡ Performance & Viewport Fixes
Decoupled Page Textures: Viewport zooming and panning operate on GPU textures without re-decoding or re-rasterizing the page on each frame.
Navigation Settings Fix: Fixed text overlap in Navigation settings tab (tab == 3) by properly placing the page curl toggle at row 6 and the continuous scroll note below it.
Natural Numeric Sorting: Multi-digit runs are ordered numerically (compareNatural / naturalCompare) with overflow safety.
